mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO theme.ast_facility (category, source_id, name_en, name_ar, subtype, sub_category, capacity, students, staff, floors, is_public, status, park_id, gisid, attrs, centroid, geom) VALUES
(#{r.category}, #{r.sourceId}, #{r.nameEn}, #{r.nameAr}, #{r.subtype}, #{r.subCategory}, #{r.capacity}, #{r.students}, #{r.staff}, #{r.floors}, #{r.isPublic}, #{r.status}, #{r.parkId}, #{r.gisid}, #{r.attrsJson}::jsonb, theme.inner_point(), )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE theme.ast_facility p SET name_en = coalesce(p.name_en, d.name_en), name_ar = coalesce(p.name_ar, d.name_ar), attrs = coalesce(p.attrs, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(d.attrs, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('dmtDetail', d.source_id) FROM theme.ast_facility d WHERE p.category = 'park' AND d.category = 'park_detail' AND p.geom && d.centroid AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, d.centroid); DELETE FROM theme.ast_facility d WHERE d.category = 'park_detail' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM theme.ast_facility p WHERE p.category = 'park' AND p.geom && d.centroid AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, d.centroid)); UPDATE theme.ast_facility SET category = 'park', park_id = source_id WHERE category = 'park_detail'
UPDATE theme.ast_facility SET area_sqm = round(ST_Area(geom::geography)::numeric, 1) WHERE category = 'park'

UPDATE theme.ast_facility f SET plot_key = p.plot_key FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE f.gisid IS NOT NULL AND p.gisid = f.gisid; UPDATE theme.ast_facility f SET plot_key = p.plot_key FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE f.plot_key IS NULL AND p.cancel_date IS NULL AND p.geom && f.centroid AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, f.centroid)

UPDATE theme.ast_facility f SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = c.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE c.geom && f.centroid AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, f.centroid); UPDATE theme.ast_facility f SET district_key = d.district_key, municipality_code = d.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_district d WHERE f.district_key IS NULL AND d.geom && f.centroid AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, f.centroid)
